intent: Provide an explicit strict 24-slot index-set object {0..23} to serve as a typed carrier for cautious scope-extension probes beyond the physical n=12 scaffold, without implying any Z_12 identification, phase embedding, theta export, or QW-2191 discharge.

occurs_as.scope_extension_probe_carrier: Used by probe-level Zn scope-extension work (e.g. P461 scan; P462 Z24 mode-index assignment candidate).

hard_limits: Does not identify this carrier with the physical n=12 nad12 scaffold.
Does not define a canonical phase embedding into U(1).
Does not export theta_1/theta_2 and does not claim O(2)-cut closure.
Does not claim QW-2191 discharge or ToE closure.
